To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $150,$ and the percentage is $0.4%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
0.4%=0.4÷100=0.004
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =0.4%\times 150 \\  & =0.004\times 150 \\  & =0.6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $0.4%$ of $150$ is $0.6.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
0.4%=\frac{0.4}{100}=\frac{0.4\times 10}{100\times 10}=\frac{4}{1,000}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =0.4%\times 150 \\  & =\frac{4}{1,000}\times 150 \\  & =\frac{600}{1,000} \\  & =0.6\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $0.4%$ of $150$ is $0.6.$
